lines: (Mrs. Wren peers at you over her glasses.)
Yes? This is an antiques shop. Everything is old and everything is precious. Including me. Do not touch.
I'm closing for lunch. Lunch is twelve o'clock to one o'clock. Not 'about twelve'. Twelve.

rotate: That clock is ninety years old. It chimes on Tuesdays. Only Tuesdays. It knows what it likes.
The cobwebs in the window are for Halloween. They are not real cobwebs. I would never allow real cobwebs.
Kip tried to sell me my own lamp once. I have not forgotten.
You have good manners. That is rarer than any antique. ...You may touch the teapot. Gently.
